before: array_filter with an explicit callback keeps entries whose values satisfy that callback. It preserves the original keys rather than rebuilding zero-based indexes. Without a callback its truthiness policy can drop zero, so name the rule deliberately.

array_values returns the values under consecutive integer keys. PHP arrays support both maps and lists; preserving keys matters when preparing a JSON list or indexing by position. array_keys returns the key list, and implode joins a list of values using the supplied separator. These functions return results without changing the original variable.
